high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account @sadiesink_. The post features a black-and-white photograph of a certificate titled "Certificate of Excellence for Interpretive Exorcism Dance," awarded to Sadie Sink on April 14, 2025. The certificate has decorative borders and a seal at the bottom left corner. Below the photo, there is a caption that reads: "Took my final bow as Shelby yesterday ❤️ I am so grateful to have been apart of this show..." This indicates that Sadie Sink is reflecting on her performance in a role named Shelby, possibly in a theater production
